# Lungrin's Lawncare

> Locally owned and owner-operated lawn care, rolled longleaf pine straw installation, flowerbed cleanups, bush & hedge trimming, pond/lake shoreline clearing, fence line clearing, gutter cleaning, and debris hauling based in Flora, Mississippi — serving Flora, Pocahontas, Madison (Annandale), Gluckstadt, Ridgeland, North Jackson, Bentonia, and Yazoo County.

## Core Services
- **Residential, Commercial & Acreage Mowing:** Commercial zero-turn turf striping, string trimming, 90-degree vertical concrete edging, and full hardscape blow-off.
- **Rolled Longleaf Pine Straw & Mulch Installation:** Complete flowerbed weeding, spaded trench borders, thick longleaf pine straw or hardwood mulch coverage, and tightly hand-tucked rolled fronts.
- **Flowerbed Cleanups & Ornamental Planting:** Sod removal for new curved beds, dead shrub extraction, new shrub and living-privacy-fence tree planting.
- **Bush, Hedge & Small Tree Trimming:** Seasonal shaping, hard size reductions, overhanging fence-line limb pruning, and 100% clipping haul-off.
- **Pond Perimeters, Fence Lines & Bush Hogging:** 360-degree pond and lake shoreline clearing, vine-choked fence reclamation, and bush hogging + finish mowing on overgrown lots.
- **Leaf Cleanups, Gutter Cleaning & Junk Hauling:** Full-yard fall/spring leaf removal, hand-cleared roof gutters and downspouts, and trailer junk/debris cleanouts.
